     × an invalid colour entered during a save stays marked after the save confirms, until Discard
     × Use theirs clears a problem it resolves
     × a preview writes nothing; a mode change retires it; a late preview never lands over newer text
     × Apply writes at once and the clean draft shows what was applied; a failed apply keeps the text and preview
     × Apply with unsaved edits asks first: keeping them writes nothing; discarding applies, and an edit made meanwhile stays
